summary: Iteration 175 — Webstore Setup Tab & Flow: Consolidated setup tab, default tab logic, and horizontal scrollbar removal. All 16 acceptance criteria tested. 14/16 directly verified via browser automation; 2 code-verified (no products case & branding btn since test store has products and branding complete).
critical_code_review_comments: launchReady() only checks hasProducts — Stripe onboarding is not required to launch (gate is intentionally relaxed). This is intentional per the code.
DialogContent has aria-describedby warning (Missing Description or aria-describedby) — non-blocking but worth noting for accessibility.
setup-flow-branding-btn only renders when !hasBranding — not testable with current test store (branding is set). Code logic is correct.
setup-flow-launch-btn is disabled when canLaunch=false — not testable with current test store (has products). Code logic is correct.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing test store fc0bad7e-9040-477e-93b9-a3f0b1a2df90 (Preview Storefront QA, business type, pending status).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Setup tab is fully functional. Pending store fc0bad7e opens to Setup tab by default; active stores open to Dashboard. The setup-flow-branding-btn only appears when store.branding is not set — this store has branding so it's not shown. The setup-flow-launch-btn is enabled for this store (has 1 product). A store with 0 products would show launch btn disabled and Products step 'Action Needed' badge. WebstoreOwnerConnectCard is embedded in the Stripe step with 'Not Connected' badge.
